turns.q: How many days do I have to return something?
turns.replyTail: You have 14 days from delivery to submit your return request. After submitting it through the returns portal, US orders must be dropped off with the carrier within 30 days.

turns.q: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
turns.replyTail: For US returns, a flat $16.99 USD return-shipping fee is deducted from your refund or store credit, so it isn’t paid separately upfront. If the item arrived faulty, a free return label is provided after assessment and the full refund is processed to your original payment method.

turns.q: How long until I get my refund once you receive it?
turns.replyTail: Eligible US refunds are processed within 5 business days after your return is received by our warehouse.

turns.q: Can I exchange for a different size or option instead of a refund?
turns.replyTail: MESHKI doesn’t offer direct exchanges. To get a different size or style, submit an eligible return through the returns portal and select store credit. Once the return is processed, you can use the credit to place a new order for your preferred option. The original shipping cost isn’t included in the credit.

turns.q: Are any items final sale / non-returnable?
turns.replyTail:
Yes. Items marked Final Sale are non-returnable and aren’t eligible for a refund, store credit, or exchange unless MESHKI confirms the item is faulty.

Earrings and underwear accessories are also non-returnable for hygiene reasons. Final Sale status is shown on the product page and during checkout. Faulty Final Sale items require a manual review.

turns.q: Do I need the original packaging to return something?
turns.replyTail:
Original packaging isn’t required for standard returns, but it’s highly recommended if you still have it. Please make sure the item is securely packed to help prevent damage in transit.

Selected Bridal styles must be returned in the original MESHKI box, with the returns ribbon and hanger tag intact.
